purpose: Control for the merged-vs-unmerged pixel comparison in merge-integrity.json: does the test detect a real index-precision corruption?
method: Largest merged mesh (scene-wide merge, MERGED_scene_ALL_MI_WoodTrim, 117,608 vertices) re-created with a 16-bit index (what an Uint16 index attribute would do to indices above 65,535), rendered at 640x360 in p5-east-aerial, shadows off, compared with the unmerged render.
reading: the corruption is detected (2.2% of pixels differ by more than 24/255, mean 1.3); the real merge differs by 0.01 on average and has no pixel over 24. All 1,706 merged meshes of the six modes use 32-bit indices.
